latest_static_crate_entity_experiment.question: Do room-scene CRATEM references correspond to an interactive salvage-crate entity, rather than only a generic decorative crate?
latest_static_crate_entity_experiment.finding: The selected CARG room MXML has three RefCrateM nodes targeting SPACEBASE/PROPS/CRATEM.SCENE.MBIN. The matching CRATEM entity defines GenericReward interaction, Id R_ABAND_CRATE, ScanName UI_SALVAGE_CRATE, and crate scanner icon. Separately, the DECORATION/CRATEM_PLACEMENT entity defines PartID _ABAND_CRATE_M; its placement scene is a locator.
latest_static_crate_entity_experiment.interpretation: Confirms these referenced CRATEM objects are configured salvage crates and supports the static scene index's salvage category. Does not prove every such prop spawns in the world, map it to the blue_crate F7 label, reveal runtime room selection, or predict total count.
